constraints: WIREFRAME FIRST (Visual Change Law ①): the lens changes /activity's composition → founder-approved wireframe before any code; then the PREVIEW GATE (real rig, desktop AND mobile, visually complete — every img naturalWidth>0) before any deploy. BACKLOG A1 meta says verbatim: '⚑ wireframe + preview (Founder)'.

ACCESS MODEL: /activity is PUBLIC (S1, PREVIEW_LABELLED, PublicRoute). The lens must NEVER wall the Protocol view — signed-out visitors keep today's full public feed; Mine signed-out = a conversion state (sign in on Member Home), never an error and never a teaser of others' data (contract §S1).

OWN-ROW DISCIPLINE: Mine's data comes ONLY from the auth zone self-readbacks (session cookie the only input, S4-gated, bound account never echoed). NEVER filter the public feed by the connected wagmi address — the wagmi account is not the SIWE session and client-guessed identity is the forbidden shortcut.

NO NEW SERVER SURFACE unless the wireframe proves a gap: /api/auth/member-purchases + /introduction-rows + /member-standing (+ /season-standing, /member-inbox) already carry everything Mine can show. If one IS added: guard-auth-zone discipline verbatim + RED-first pins (throttle, cookie-only, discipline+address scan, no req.query/params).

BUNDLE BOUNDARY (guard-access-state rule 15): no static import of @/wallet/ outside App.tsx — the Mine lens reaches walletSession via dynamic import (the lib/useSignedIn.ts idiom) or a flag-gated lazy wallet component; rule 17 keeps wallet fetches on literal /api/auth/... URLs.

SEGMENTED CONTROL, NOT TABS (contract §S1 Adopt) — but WORK-FIRST outranks the mockup: the page still opens on the work; reference material stays in the Z5 expander; no unread state on the feed (the bell owns unread — contract recommendation 4).
FULL-SCREEN LAW S7-d: never a page-level max-width on /activity; wide screens multiply columns; only the sentence is bounded in ch (renderLine grid, LiveActivityFeed :811-830).

ADDRESS LAW (2026-07-24/25, ANSWERED FOREVER): addresses are PUBLIC — short form + explorer link everywhere, full address in served payloads where the chain emits it; any masking/fail-closing on an address is a BUG. Do not re-import the benchmark HTML's dated 'de-identified' phrasing.

ANTI-FINANCIALIZATION + honesty contract invariants on every Mine row: verify-first (every figure carries its proof anchor), static neutral amounts via usdFromRaw/formatAmount (import, never re-derive — check ④), honest three states, pending stays pending.

RED FIRST (check ②): every new pin (lens never walls Protocol; Mine is own-row; segmented control present) is written failing before the fix; reverting the slice must turn it red. The design guards with pinned per-file counts (guard-focus-visible '2' on LiveActivityFeed :133, guard-type-scale ceiling :344, guard-contrast-aa pairs :340-363, guard-touch-target) WILL red on new controls — recount and update ledgers in the same slice with written reasons.

DOCS RIDE THE SLICE (one consolidated pass): BACKLOG.html A1 tick + C3 unblock, MEMBER_HOME_FINISH_ORDER step 8, DESIGN_ROADMAP boxes, OPEN_QUEUE evidence, SESSION_STATE boot block — same commit(s) as the slice; SEO battery only if the registry/posture moves.

DEPLOY VERDICT: if no server change, this is a client-only visible slice → 🚀 DEPLOY (it changes thesyndicate.money); the founder ordered it ('go' on engraved #1), so it likely rides its own cycle rather than batching; state the verdict in one line.
WORD LAW: founder-facing reports in human words only — 'commission' never acquisition-cost vocabulary; never 'PII' on any surface; the founder decides content ON SCREEN (paste full copy inline).
risks: Default-lens choice (Mine-first for signed-in members vs Protocol-always) is an OPEN founder decision (contract §S1 decision 1, recommend Mine-first with fallback-to-Protocol-when-empty) — it must be resolved at the wireframe gate, not silently decided in code.

The Mine rows and Protocol lines have different identities: served feed dedups on kind:txHash:logIndex, but own-purchase rows carry NO logIndex — merging the two lens populations into one list would create key collisions and double-counting; the lens should SWITCH populations, not merge them.

LiveActivityFeed's chip counts, era band, seat-overlap note, live poll, and Load-more arithmetic are all Protocol-lens machinery with one-authority pins (chipCount :671-732) — the Mine lens must not reuse or occlude those counters (a Mine 'total' has its own authority: the served own-rows length).

Line :1373 'A seat's own activity already has its own view.' was written when /member was that view — after the lens ships this sentence is stale on the very page that gained the view; fix it in the slice WITHOUT breaking the guard-feature-truth fragment two sentences later.

Session vs connection states: connected-but-not-signed (wallet connected, no SIWE) and signed-but-no-seat both return honest S1/S4 payloads with failureReason — each needs its own honest UI state; rendering the generic error for a not-signed visitor would violate the conversion-state requirement.

The auth zone is dark-by-default in prod behind SYNDICATE_AUTH_ENABLED (authExposure.ts) — the Mine lens must fail closed to the conversion state when /api/auth answers 404-shaped darkness (fetchers already return null; do not spin forever).

Bundle-size/entry discipline: pulling wallet fetchers statically into the public /activity chunk reds guard-access-state; the dynamic-import seam has an async first paint — the lens needs a checking state so members never flash the signed-out composition (useSignedIn's checking flag is the precedent).

The a1 benchmark HTML's 'people de-identified' Protocol description is a pre-address-law fossil; copying it into new copy would re-open a settled ruling the founder killed twice (2026-07-24 and 2026-07-25).
Deep-link grammar: ?facet= already lives on the URL (:339-353, replaceState) — a ?lens= param must coexist without clobbering facet state on selectFilter's URL rewrite.

constraints: WIREFRAME GATE OWED (from the records, not opinion): BACKLOG.html A1 row carries « ⚑ wireframe + preview (Founder) »; MEMBER_HOME_FINISH_ORDER names step 8 among the wireframe steps and orders SYSTEM-FIRST before it; the founder-approved A0 newsroom mockup contains NO Mine element — the 2026-07-22 approval does NOT cover the lens composition. Sequence: inventory on screen → wireframe (carrying the four unanswered §S1 founder decisions as options) → founder GO → code → PREVIEW GATE (localhost URL, desktop AND mobile widths, both themes, every img naturalWidth>0) → deploy.

A1 HONESTY CONTRACT (TIER-0, docs/reference/A1_BENCHMARK_AND_HONESTY_CONTRACT.md): segmented control NOT tabs; verify-first on every row; own-row + hide-nothing-on-chain (short-form addresses shown, red line = name/alias/email/directory); anti-financialization skin; honest three states (loading skeleton, teaching empty, error+retry — pending stays pending); accessible by construction (role=feed/aria semantics, aria-live polite, 44px targets, both themes AA).

ACCESS MODEL (CANON_ACCESS_MODEL §A, verbatim precedent): the notification « "Mine" inbox » is member-account (sign-in wall — teaser + one CTA, zero personal figures; connected-not-signed still walled; signed-no-seat → conversion) while « All/Protocol » is public ("fully open… no personal figures"). Applied: /activity NEVER walls the public view; Protocol is the signed-out default; Mine signed-out = invitation only. Gate on fetchSessionState()==='S4', NEVER the wagmi address (§B; the /wallet leak lesson). Q-B: a disconnected-but-signed member keeps Mine.

WALLET IMPORT BOUNDARY (guard-access-state rule 15, BLOCKING): no static import of @/wallet/ outside src/wallet/ except App.tsx's three pinned specifiers. LiveActivityFeed reaches session/own-row reads ONLY via dynamic import (the useSignedIn pattern) or a lazily-mounted wallet-chunk component. Rule 17: any new fetch in the wallet module uses literal "/api/auth/..." URLs, fail-closed.

OWN-ROW DATA AVAILABLE TODAY (no new endpoint required): /api/auth/member-purchases (dated rows + transaction anchors + explorerUrl + receipt facts incl. seat/firstSeat/broughtByShort), /api/auth/introduction-rows (whoWallet + whoExplorerUrl + commissionRaw + anatomy), /api/auth/member-standing (memberNumber + own entry receipt), /api/auth/member-inbox. Matching Mine rows against the public feed must NEVER key on the client wagmi address; the compliant joins are the own-row endpoints' transaction anchors and the served memberNumber/seatNumber fields.

GUARD PINS THAT MUST SURVIVE THE EDIT: guard-one-figure regex-pins isFounderLine's body in LiveActivityFeed.tsx and drives backboneFeedClient.parseLine with fixtures; guard-feature-truth pins the Z5 fragment "What the indexer adds next" to two future keys; guard-access-state 1081 checks incl. per-file lazy-seam pins. Any pin that must move, moves in the same commit, RED-first (revert the fix → the check goes RED, or the check does not exist).

FULL-SCREEN LAW (S7-d, engraved — the founder's own catch on this very page): never a page-level max-width on /activity; wide screens fill by content columns; only the sentence is bounded, in ch. WORK-FIRST outranks the mockup: the feed opens on the work; reference material stays in the collapsed Z5.

DESIGN-SYSTEM FLOORS on the new control: 44px touch targets (the facet chips' py-3.5 sm:py-1 precedent), 12px absolute floor / 14px reading floor, gold selected-state grammar (border-gold/40 bg-gold/10 — matches both the bell tabs and the facet chips), focus-visible rings, both themes (guard-contrast-aa, guard-theme-parity, guard-touch-target, guard-type-scale, guard-focus-visible all BLOCKING).

WORD LAW: human words only on every surface and in every founder-facing report — never "PII" (guard-forbidden-copy bans it rendered), never Sx codes on a surface, "Founder" capital F, "commission" never "acquisition cost". No gain-promise glyphs; no unread pressure on the feed (the bell owns unread).

ONE-AUTHORITY FIGURES: any Mine count shown is the own-row server's word (rows.length of a complete served list is acceptable; never client arithmetic dressed as a whole-history total); the Protocol lens keeps chipCount's server-word discipline untouched.

FEATURE REGISTRY: no featureStatus key exists for the lens — none is owed at ship (a live flip only exists for keys that were future). If any surface temporarily claims the lens is "coming", that claim must register a key + guard pin first.
DEEP LINK: mirror the shipped ?facet= pattern (read once at mount, history.replaceState on change) for ?lens=; unknown values fall back to the public default.

Deploy verdict stated in one line at the end (client-only + fail-closed ⇒ likely 🚀 DEPLOY — BATCHABLE, but the founder wanted A1 next, so expect a real deploy).
risks: TENSION TO SURFACE AT THE WIREFRAME, not silently resolved: the A1 contract §S1 prescribes an on-demand "N new" pill ("never a silent auto-inject") but the SHIPPED A3 newsroom auto-injects polled lines at the top with a gold flash — and THAT behavior was founder-approved on the A0 mockup ("une nouvelle ligne glisse en haut… ta position de lecture est préservée"). Do not relitigate the shipped Protocol behavior on my own authority; put the divergence on the wireframe if the lens touches it.

The four §S1 founder decisions (default lens Mine-first vs Protocol · toggle naming · Visibility-Law confirmation for Protocol · calm no-unread) are UNANSWERED in every record searched (SESSION_STATE, OPEN_QUEUE, BACKLOG). Building on the doc's mere recommendations without the founder's word violates the content-on-screen rule — they ride the wireframe gate.

Guard-pin breakage is the likeliest RED: editing LiveActivityFeed around isFounderLine (guard-one-figure extracts its body by regex) or the Z5 prose (guard-feature-truth fragment) fails the chain if pins are not moved in the same commit.

Prerender/SEO leak: /activity is a prerendered INDEX shell — the signed-out default must remain the anonymous Protocol view or the prerender bakes a personal frame; also adding the lens without checking the served head against the new reality is the exact era-drift/truth-bug class the SEO-rides-the-slice rule exists for.

Bundle-boundary regression: one careless static `import { … } from "@/wallet/walletSession"` in components/activity/ turns guard-access-state RED and, worse, would drag wagmi/RainbowKit into the public entry chunk if the guard were loosened — the dynamic-import discipline is load-bearing, not ceremonial.

Identity mis-keying: matching "Mine" rows by the connected wagmi address is both a law violation (session-not-wagmi) and wrong under Q-B (a signed member with wallet disconnected must still see Mine). Key on session-derived facts only (own-row rows' transaction anchors, memberNumber).

Scope creep toward a server slice: no own-activity endpoint exists; inventing one by default doubles the slice across artifacts and awakens guard-auth-zone's 1302 pins. The client-side composition from existing endpoints covers the contract; a served mine-scope should only exist if the approved wireframe demands data the own-row endpoints cannot express (e.g. own archive mints/burns — note ownReads' useOwnArchiveHoldings reads balances client-side already).
The 60s Protocol poll + any Mine re-read could become two polling authorities on one page — reuse the existing poll/session-event rails, never a second timer answering the same question.
